question: does every admissibility RESULT in the deliverables carry its segment length?

rule.result_pattern: (\d+\s*个合格|\d+\s*/\s*\d+\s*合格|合格率\s*=?\s*\d|合格\s*\*\*\d|\d+\s*个窗口.*合格|\d+\s*个状态.*合格)
rule.why: at 3 s none of the nine dense windows is admissible; at 10 s eight are, so a result without its segment length can be read as the opposite
